title: Orange
body:
"Oranges are round citrus fruits with bright orange skin and juicy, tangy flesh."

Description

The Orange is a item that can be found on Acacia (Finlay Island) trees, in the desert area.

It may be sold to Jer Junkman for $150 per Orange. In its jam form it may be sold for $600.

Slightly increases chopping power when eaten.

When put into a Composter, the fill level increases by ~2.85% per orange.
